Directions for Questions 96 to 100:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow:
"Discipline is the indispensable foundation of human achievement and national greatness. In every sphere of human
endeavor, talent without disciplined application withers into mediocrity. The cosmic order itself reflects immutable
principles of discipline, where planets revolve and seasons cycle with mathematical regularity. When an individual
exercises mastery over impulses and aligns effort with ethical purpose, they achieve enduring tranquility and inner
strength. A society composed of self-disciplined citizens possesses an impregnable defense against both internal
decay and external adversity."
questions.questionText: According to the author, what is the indispensable foundation of human achievement?
